# Instruments: Bass

A note's `pitch` uses the **MIDI pitch (60 = middle C)**. Latest list: `muser instruments --family bass`.

| instrument | Recommended range | Polyphony | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bass.finger` | 28–60 | 4 | Fingerstyle electric bass: round and full; the standard bass for pop / funk / R&B |
| `bass.slap` | 28–60 | 4 | Slap bass: percussive and punchy; funk / disco |
| `bass.acid` | 24–60 | 1 | TB-303 style acid bass (monophonic, overlapping notes glide); acid house / techno |
| `bass.acid_squelch` | 24–60 | 1 | acid bass with higher resonance and envelope, a stronger squelch |
| `bass.acid_square` | 24–60 | 1 | acid bass, square-wave version, more hollow |

## Adjustable parameters (instrument_params)

Override the sound of the chosen instrument/preset; write only the items you want to change, the rest stay as they are. `muser instruments <name>` shows the preset's current values.

| Parameter | Range | Automation | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decay` | 0.05 – 60 s | next note | How long the string rings while held (time for middle C to decay 60 dB). Short = muted; long = long ringing tail |
| `release` | 0.01 – 10 s | next note | Decay time after release (damping) |
| `tone` | 200 – 20000 Hz | ✓ | Final low-pass: brightness of the body/pickup. 2000 dark; 5000 normal; 10000+ very bright |
| `pluck_brightness` | 100 – 20000 Hz | next note | Pluck brightness: fingernail/pick is bright (5000+), fingertip is dark (1000-2000) |
| `pluck_position` | 0.02 – 0.5 | next note | Pluck position (fraction of the way from the bridge). 0.05 near the bridge, thin and bright; 0.5 mid-string, round and hollow |
| `buzz` | 0 – 1 | next note | Fret buzz. 0 clean; 0.3+ percussive (slap) |

Automation column: ✓ = notes already sounding follow immediately; next note = affects only notes that start afterward; — = cannot be automated. See [automation.md](../automation.md).

Preset values of each instrument:

| instrument | `decay` | `release` | `tone` | `pluck_brightness` | `pluck_position` | `buzz` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bass.finger` | 6 | 0.12 | 2600 | 1600 | 0.2 | 0 |
| `bass.slap` | 5 | 0.1 | 6000 | 9000 | 0.28 | 0.45 |

### Tuning examples

- Duller, shorter fingerstyle bass

  ```json
  { "instrument": "bass.finger", "instrument_params": {"tone": 1200, "decay": 1.0} }
  ```

- Screaming acid (together with accent notes)

  ```json
  { "instrument": "bass.acid", "instrument_params": {"cutoff": 250, "resonance": 0.9, "env_mod": 0.8, "decay": 0.3, "accent": 1.0} }
  ```


## Tips and common mistakes

- `bass.acid*` is monophonic (polyphony 1): starting the next note before the previous one ends produces a 303-style glide; for separated notes, leave gaps between the notes.
- Bass generally sits in 28-55; below 28 many speakers cannot reproduce it.
- When bass and kick land on a strong beat together, you can put a compressor on the bass to make the level steadier.
